title: Epilepsy / EEG Challenges — 30, by difficulty
note: Real clinical + technical + AI/governance challenges across Basic / Intermediate / High, each with the AI mitigation.

challenges.challenge: Poor electrode contact / high impedance (>10 kΩ)
challenges.ai_help: Real-time impedance alerts + signal-quality scoring before recording

challenges.challenge: Eye-blink and muscle (EMG) artifacts contaminate signal
challenges.ai_help: Auto artifact classifier (ICA) + per-channel artifact heatmap
Smart-form completion + required-field gating at intake
Mobile quick-entry + auto-severity scoring + reminders
Motion detection from accelerometer + flag noisy epochs

challenges.challenge: Short routine EEG misses interictal events
challenges.ai_help: Sleep-deprived / prolonged protocols + activation procedures
Resampling + sampling-rate normalization in the pipeline
10-20 channel validation + montage auto-detect
EMR/document extraction + medication reconciliation
Calm-protocol checklist + quality re-take prompts
Consensus AI across reviewers + Cohen's kappa tracking

challenges.challenge: Distinguishing artifact from true epileptiform activity
challenges.ai_help: Spike detector with morphology features + expert validation loop

challenges.challenge: Class imbalance — few seizure vs many normal epochs
challenges.ai_help: SMOTE / class-weighting + cost-sensitive metrics (recall-first)
GroupKFold by subject + patient-specific temporal split

challenges.challenge: Localizing focal onset zone from scalp EEG
challenges.ai_help: Band-power topography + GNN connectivity (candidate regions)
Electroclinical concordance scoring + video-EEG alignment
AI summarization + event pre-flagging for reviewer
Domain adaptation + transfer learning + honest reporting
Mutual information + RFE + PCA dimensionality reduction
1D-CNN / LSTM / Transformer on windowed signals
Pre-ictal forecasting models + lead-time evaluation
Treatment-response features + DRE-criteria alerting

challenges.challenge: Deep models underperform on small clinical data
challenges.ai_help: Classical 47-feature RF baseline + spectrogram CNN when data grows

challenges.challenge: Explainability of black-box predictions for clinical trust
challenges.ai_help: SHAP / Grad-CAM vs expert ground-truth + interpretable surrogate
Disparate-impact + equal-opportunity gates per subgroup
On-device edge inference + buffer-and-sync + SOS
Late-fusion ensemble + concordance scoring
Self-supervised pretraining + fine-tune on labeled subset
Decision audit rows + HITL override + EU AI Act mapping
Federated training + no raw-data egress + secure aggregation
